analysis: The PR changes only docs/reference/configuration.md. It bumps the 'Last updated' date (line 3) and adds one row at head line 414 documenting DARKBLOOM_TTFT_GDN_BLOCKED, an environment variable that selects the Gated DeltaNet prompt-window kernel for qwen3_5, qwen3_5_moe and prism_hadamard_qwen35 models. No source code, wire protocol, attestation, authorization, key custody, prefix-cache, or coordinator behavior changes in the supplied evidence. The documented behavior is that the default probe keeps the four-row kernel only where it reproduces gated_delta_step bit for bit on the GPU, and decode, MTP verification and masked updates always use the stock kernel. Forced 'packed' or 'rows' skips that parity check and is described as A/B measurement only. The setting is a local process environment variable, so setting it requires operator control of the provider environment. That is already inside the ADV-001 / TB-003 operator-trust model, where the operator can already modify weights or the binary. The row also states it is forwarded to the LaunchAgent. This is a documentation claim only; the actual passthrough allowlist (LaunchAgent.swift) and the kernel code in libs/mlx-swift-lm GatedDelta.swift were not supplied, so those claims are unverified. A forced kernel could affect numerical output (T-007 / T-027 class correctness), but only by operator choice, and no actual code change is visible here. Remaining integration question: if the underlying PR also changes GatedDelta.swift or the LaunchAgent passthrough allowlist, those changes need review for numerical-parity and environment-forwarding implications, and none is supplied in this batch. No security regression identified in the docs-only change.
